title: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues
intro: LongMemEval-V2 把 agent memory 评价写成 context gathering：memory module 先消费大规模 multimodal trajectory history，再为固定 reader 返回不超过 200K tokens 的 evidence package。它直接测的是 bounded evidence construction，不是 online learning、未来 web-task success 或端到端 agent competence。（§3.3；Appendix E，PDF pp. 5–6、26–27）
reading_scope: 完整读了 arXiv v1 的 §§1–6、Appendix A–E、Tables 1–11 与 Figures 1–7，共 32 个 PDF pages；references 只用于 lineage 定位。另检查 official code 的 paper-day release、2026-08-05 benchmark-metadata query-boundary fix 与 2026-08-09 current source，并执行 source-linked CPU-only boundary test、公开 question/tier-map exact-pair census 与 synthetic renderer feasibility audit；没有运行 benchmark、controller、模型、reader、judge 或真实 trajectory resolution。

payload.whyRead: 这篇把“经验”从一句产品隐喻逼成了一个可定位的 evaluation object：25M–115M token 的历史怎样经过 memory 与 query controller 进入 bounded active context。真正值得保留的也不是 72.5% 单点，而是 paper、paper-day release、August query-boundary fix 与 current source 之间的 protocol drift，以及 current postprocessor 允许 controller prose 在没有有效支持时先进入 built memory context 的事实。它让 retrieval miss、controller assistance、evidence provenance、reader error 与 cost accounting 不再被同一个 memory score 吞掉。
keyPoints: Evaluation object：451 个问题分别配一份有序 trajectory haystack；memory 经 Insert→Query 返回 context，固定 Qwen3.5-9B reader 在 200K-token cap 内回答。Small 平均 100 trajectories / 25.6M tokens，Medium 约 498 / 114.8M。（§3.2–§3.3；Figure 3，PDF pp. 4–6）

Correlated tiers：Small 在 domain 内共享 haystack；Medium 为 question-specific，却沿用 Small 的 answer seeds 后增加 fillers；zero-support abstention 与 source anchor 复用同一 haystack。两层不是 902 个独立 questions。（Appendix A.2–A.4，PDF pp. 15–17）

Controller-assisted headline：AgentRunbook-C 的 Small / Medium 为 74.9% / 70.1%，equal-tier average 72.5%；Codex 为 69.3%，strongest RAG 为 48.5%。但 C 的 gotcha 两层都低于 Codex，Medium overall gain 没有 paper legend 下的 significance marker。（Table 2，PDF p. 9）

Versioned boundary：paper-day AgentRunbook-R planner 使用 question type 与 original goals；August fix 才把 backend context 改成 opaque invocation ID。paper-day C backend API 可见 raw question item，但 direct-executed release sandbox payload builder 仍只返回 query text/image，不能夸成 gold 或 metadata 已转入 sandbox。（Appendix Tables 9–10；official source history）

Executed contract test：current Codex postprocessing 会在 spans 为空、unknown、越界或只指向 opposite-value decoy 时继续把 answer-like memory_markdown 放进 built memory context；current AgentRunbook-C source 继承并调用这组 methods，optional evidence gate 也不要求 directly_supported 至少有一个 valid span。（public synthetic artifact）

argumentMap.step: 01 · 先把经验变成 bounded evidence task
argumentMap.claim: 作者不让 memory system 直接操作网站或生成最终 benchmark answer，而是把它放在 trajectory history 与固定 reader 之间；这样 retrieval / synthesis 与 reader answering 可以被分别观察。

argumentMap.step: 02 · 用稀疏 needles 压测环境知识
argumentMap.claim: 451 个问题覆盖 static、dynamic、workflow、gotcha 与 premise awareness；平均 answer core 只有 1.39 trajectories，却被埋进 100 或约 498 条 web-agent histories。

argumentMap.step: 03 · 比较 retrieval controller 与 file-research controller
argumentMap.claim: R 从 raw states、events 与 notes 中生成结构化 queries；C 将 trajectories 文件化，让 coding agent 先分类、短列、检索 spans 并写 narrative context，再交固定 reader。

argumentMap.step: 04 · 用 adverse results 与 source lineage 限定 headline
argumentMap.claim: C 整体领先并更快于 vanilla Codex，但 gotcha 退化、helper ablation 在 Medium 提高 accuracy；paper-facing metadata contract 又与 current source 不同，因此结果属于特定 controller protocol，而不是 method name 的 timeless property。

methodNotes.label: Question and coverage construction
methodNotes.text: 四名学生 annotators 构造问题；frontier-model no-context failures 被用于过滤、改写或形成 distractors。answer-bearing trajectories 先由 Codex-assisted proposals 找候选，再由人确认 final minimal core；公开说明没有建立 exhaustive-negative coverage audit。

methodNotes.label: Reader and heterogeneous scoring
methodNotes.text: 固定 Qwen3.5-9B reader 使用 stochastic decoding；structured answers 做 phrase / order matching，gotcha 与 abstention 由 GPT-5.2 medium judge。UNKNOWN 恒错，abstention 的 environment-access disclaimer 也可能得分。

methodNotes.label: Query-stage latency
methodNotes.text: reported memory latency 包围 query stage；trajectory insertion / index building、context truncation、reader、judge 与 post-query consolidation 不在同一数字内。Medium question-specific workspaces 与 Small shared workspaces 的 amortization 也不同。

methodNotes.label: Source-linked local audit
methodNotes.text: 第一组公开 runner 对三个 exact Git revisions 做 AST/source-locator checks，并用 sentinel metadata 直接执行每个 revision 的 AgentRunbook-C payload builder；随后执行 current output validator / normalizer / context builder。第二组 model-free audit 遍历 451 个公开 question/tier-map rows、生成完整 selection ledger，并用三条 synthetic trajectories 定位 renderer 的真实排序面。

reportedFindings: Table 2 的 Small / Medium overall：slice RAG 42.8 / 38.1，slice+notes 51.0 / 45.9，AgentRunbook-R 58.6 / 57.0，Codex 69.9 / 68.7，AgentRunbook-C 74.9 / 70.1。（PDF p. 9）
AgentRunbook-C 在 gotchas 低于 Codex：48.3 vs 58.6（Small），44.9 vs 51.7（Medium）；Medium workflow 同为 61.3。C 的 Medium overall 70.1 vs 68.7 在论文表格中没有 significance marker。（Table 2，PDF p. 9）
移除 C helper functions 后 Medium overall 从 70.1 升到 71.8、workflow 从 61.3 升到 68.9，但 latency 增加；helper 的作用是 accuracy–latency trade，不是 uniform accuracy gain。（Table 11，PDF p. 30）

no-context pilot 与 oracle pilot 只用 323 个 non-abstention questions；Codex 的 89.7% oracle-trajectory pilot 直接从 answer-bearing files 写 final answer，不经过 main fixed-reader boundary。（Appendix B，PDF pp. 18–20）
Introduction 报 simple slice RAG average 40.1%，Table 2 的 42.8% 与 38.1% 等权平均为 40.45%；selected paper/source 没有提供能得到 40.1 的 alternative denominator。
evidenceLimits: 这是 arXiv v1 work-in-progress preprint。current official code 是 paper 之后持续修改的 successor；没有 paper-era run artifacts、per-question predictions、judge transcripts、seeds 或完整 bootstrap implementation 可独立恢复 Table 2。leaderboard source 把 paper points hard-code，不能代替 reproduction。
paper 只评估 pre-collected browser trajectories 与 fixed-reader context gathering，不评估 live online learning、未来 website task success、sensitive enterprise history、human interruption cost 或行动安全。
Small / Medium 复用同 questions 与 answer seeds，abstention/source pairs 也共享 haystacks；paired bootstrap 的 resampling unit、次数、CI、multiple-comparison 与 cluster handling 未公开。

公开 questions 与 answers 使 current benchmark-metadata query-boundary regression tests 只能防 accidental backend coupling，不能把 public leaderboard 变成 held-out test；exact question text 仍可被 unrestricted custom backend 当 lookup key。

本地 contract test 证明 current postprocessor 允许 unsupported answer-like prose，不证明 controller 实际生成过这种输出、不估计频率、不解释 paper gain，也没有测 sandbox escape。successor census 只证明三组 exact public pairs 与 intervention surface 可构造；full trajectory resolution 和 66-job controller phase 均未执行。
synthetic valid-but-decoy case 使用 exact opaque-token oracle 判断 semantic support；它足以证明没有 semantic alignment enforcement，却不是一般 natural-language entailment evaluator。

sourceTensions.label: Paper method 与 paper-day C code 已分叉
sourceTensions.observation: Appendix Table 10 说 C 的 question.json 含 ID 与 metadata；paper-day release harness/backend context 也可见 raw item，但同 revision 的 C/Codex sandbox payload builder 只序列化 query text/image。
sourceTensions.implication: 不能让 paper prose、release API visibility 与 sandbox contents 互相替代；May 72.5% 的 exact operational protocol 仍不能从 current source alone 恢复。

sourceTensions.label: Accuracy gain 在 gotcha 与 helper 上反向
sourceTensions.observation: C 的 overall average 高于 Codex，但 gotcha 两层都更低；移除 helper functions 又提高 Medium overall 与 workflow accuracy。
sourceTensions.implication: specialized controller 的收益依赖 question family 与 cost budget，不能从 aggregate 推出每个 memory ability 或 helper 都改善。

sourceTensions.label: Structured output 没有形成 evidence contract
sourceTensions.observation: current output schema 同时允许 answer-like memory_markdown 与 empty spans；normalizer 只删除 unknown / out-of-range spans，context builder 仍先发送 prose。optional evidence gate 只检查 status/policy pairing，而且 evidence_status / answer_policy 没有被渲染进 built memory context。
sourceTensions.implication: structured JSON 提高 addressability，却不能单独证明 built memory context 中的 synthesis 被 cited trajectory 支持；prose admission 与 span provenance 需要额外 contract。

editorialInferences.label: A context package is an authored evidence object
editorialInferences.text: query controller 不只是找回旧内容：它决定 query routing、选择 spans、生成 narrative、排列 evidence 并在 token cap 下占据前缀。它产出的 context package 本身需要 provenance、admission 与 truncation semantics，不能继承 raw trajectory 的 authority。
editorialInferences.boundary: 这是由 paper method、prefix context order 与 local contract test 推出的 editorial synthesis；论文没有提出完整的 provenance-enforcing context package schema。

editorialInferences.label: Query-boundary isolation and benchmark integrity are different
editorialInferences.text: opaque invocation ID 能消除 honest backend 对 question type、gold row 与 original goals 的 API coupling；公开 question text / answers、question-specific haystack fingerprints 与 unrestricted code execution仍是另一组 leaderboard-integrity问题。
editorialInferences.boundary: current benchmark-metadata query-boundary tests 证明 direct-interface narrowing；它们不是 held-out benchmark、安全 sandbox 或反作弊机制，也没有证据表明 reported methods 做了 answer lookup。

editorialInferences.label: Experienced colleague is a layered claim
editorialInferences.text: trajectory authority、retrieval、controller synthesis、reader comprehension、task execution 与 action authorization 是六个不同层次。LME-V2 对前四层中的 bounded QA path 有价值，但不能用一个 context-gathering score替后两层签字。
editorialInferences.boundary: 这是对 evaluation object 与 Appendix E limitations 的 architecture-level interpretation，不是论文声称已经验证 online colleague competence。

openProtocols.title: Alias × order × prose-admission protocol
openProtocols.question: current-source AgentRunbook-C controller 的 selected evidence 与 prose 会不会随 trajectory identity aliases 或 observable order 改变；这种变化在 exact-haystack answerable/abstention pairs 中是否不同？
openProtocols.method: 选择 locked public files 中全部三组 exact ordered-Medium answerable/abstention classes；六个 questions 各跑 Small / Medium × C00/C10/C01/C11。alias 使用 rank-preserving opaque IDs；direct order treatment 是预生成的 concise/full summary-record order，insertion/index/manifest 只同步为 consistency surfaces。另加每个 question-tier 一个 exact-input repeat 与每个 question 一个 empty-memory control。
openProtocols.fixtures: 三组 web-procedure Medium families、六个 question IDs、共享 web Small haystack 与待一次性解析的 locked trajectories union；预计 48 factorial + 12 repeat + 6 no-memory，共 66 query-method jobs。
openProtocols.controls: pair 内共享 alias map 与 permutation；所有 Small probes 共享一组 map/permutation；hash-derived ledger 固定 aliases、permutations、repeat cells 与 66-job order；fresh workspace/process；P prose-only、E valid-evidence-only、B unchanged combined、G human provenance-gated packages。没有 replacement class。
openProtocols.measures: ledger 将 state/trajectory set 固定为 de-aliased Jaccard distance，将 prose 固定为 NFKC/whitespace-normalized character Levenshtein ratio，并固定 evidence-context canonical JSON hash、completion/retry 与 invalid/empty coding；按三组 Medium family 与共享一个 haystack 的六个 Small queries 分开汇总，不给 p-value、CI 或 bootstrap。
openProtocols.limitations: 这是 prospectively specified 但未获 gate release 的 66-job protocol。三组 classes 全部属于 web procedure；full trajectory resolution 未运行，exact intended CLI signing-trust gate 为 HOLD，controller-tool network-isolation preflight 也未通过，controller jobs 为 0。它不能恢复 May run、测 reader/accuracy 或外推到其他 strata。

contributions.title: Versioned benchmark-metadata query and answer-evidence boundary audit
contributions.basis: Paper-facing audit of Appendix Tables 9–10 plus official source at the paper-day release, the 2026-08-05 query-boundary fix, and the 2026-08-09 current revision. Current Codex output behavior is locally executed through the exact validator, normalizer, and context builder; AgentRunbook-C inheritance and call sites are source-inspected.
contributions.boundary: This is a versioned source/payload audit and synthetic built-context contract test, not a LongMemEval-V2 benchmark reproduction. It does not execute the reader, estimate controller behavior frequency, explain Table 2 gains, prove answer lookup or sandbox escape, apply to AgentRunbook-C V2, or validate any deployed memory system.
contributions.method: Run sixteen AST- and payload-level checks across three exact Git revisions, each with blob/function/line/excerpt locators and sentinel metadata; then run 18 standard-library-only AXTree rows with two opaque answer tokens through current CodexMemory output validation, span normalization, and built-context construction.
contributions.environment: macOS 26.5.2 arm64；Python 3.13.3；Python standard library only；targeted Python socket DNS/connect guard；local Git object reads only；no model, reader, judge, tokenizer or embedding calls.
contributions.fixture: Each fresh workspace contains a two-state support trajectory whose final AXTree carries the opaque answer token and a one-state AMBER decoy. Cases cover valid support, evidence-only, empty spans, missing trajectory, out-of-range state, decoy evidence, two evidence-gate inconsistencies, a syntactic policy mismatch and an empty control.
contributions.controls: Supported and evidence-only positives, empty negative, syntactic gate mismatch, independent CERULEAN/MAGENTA token repetitions, exact source revision checks, clean checkout requirement, source-file hashes and checked-in full normalized outputs / built memory contexts.
contributions.rawResult: All sixteen versioned source/payload checks passed. Supported/evidence-only controls passed and the status/policy mismatch was rejected. Six predeclared evidence-binding failure patterns, each replicated with two opaque tokens, left answer-like prose in built memory context without selected token support; twelve rows failed in total.
contributions.derivedResult: The fix/current direct query boundary is narrower than the release boundary. At current source, the Codex postprocessor does not enforce that answer-like memory_markdown included in built memory context is supported by valid selected trajectory spans; current AgentRunbook-C inherits and invokes those methods without another semantic gate.
contributions.limitations: The support oracle is exact-token presence in synthetic AXTree text; the opposite-value decoy is valid for this fixture, not a general entailment judge. Six designed patterns and twelve replicated rows are not population estimates. No reader, benchmark data or model behavior was measured; current regression tests were located in source, not executed by this runner.

contributions.title: Alias/order pre-registration and public exact-pair census
contributions.basis: Locked public questions, Small and Medium haystack maps, official current-source renderer and AgentRunbook-C/Codex boundary files, plus a bounded preflight of the exact intended Codex CLI candidate.
contributions.boundary: This is a deterministic selection census and intervention-feasibility audit. It does not resolve the full selected trajectory union, run a controller or model, estimate behavior frequency, execute a reader or judge, score the benchmark, attribute Table 2, or reconstruct the May controller run.
contributions.method: Hash every eligible ordered Medium haystack, select every same-domain/base-type class containing answerable and abstention members, retain a complete class ledger, inspect the current renderer contract, and execute forward/reverse filesystem materialization plus rank-preserving and order-reversing alias controls. Then pre-seed reordered official summaries and exercise the exact current ensure/sandbox-link path.
contributions.environment: macOS 26.5.2 arm64；Python 3.13.3 standard library plus Git CLI；locked local public files and clean official source checkout；no network, model, controller, reader, judge, tokenizer or embedding call in the audit.
contributions.fixture: All 451 public question records and both locked tier maps drive selection. Two synthetic trajectories share one renderer tie group; a third differs in start URL and goal.
contributions.controls: Exact source/data hashes, complete eligibility and exclusion ledgers, canonical-array equality behind every shared hash, selected Small equality, forward/reverse materialization, rank-preserving and order-reversing aliases, pre-seeded summary byte preservation, exact checksum file-set verification and a no-bypass exact-runtime stop rule.
contributions.rawResult: The census found 422 eligible text-only questions and excluded 29 image-bearing gotcha items. Exactly three pair-eligible ordered-Medium classes and six selected questions remained; all were web procedure and shared one 100-ID ordered Small array. Filesystem materialization-order reversal produced byte-identical official summaries; alias tie behavior matched the declared controls. Pre-seeded reordered summaries survived the exact ensure path with summary_rendered false and remained byte-identical through the sandbox-linked trajectories surface.
contributions.derivedResult: The renderer's alias tie-order behavior, the need for an explicit post-sort order surface, and the current source's pre-seeded summary-order bypass are reproducibly established. The 66-job controller phase remains HOLD with zero jobs executed because full trajectory resolution and execution gates were not passed.
contributions.limitations: The three classes are a finite census of exact public-pair support, not hidden official provenance or a representative benchmark sample. Runtime fields are an author-recorded bounded local preflight observation not independently replayed by the artifact; they are not a security finding about other releases. No controller output or reader effect exists in this artifact.

payload.editorialQuestion: 当 query controller 能读取 benchmark-derived routing hints、生成 answer-like narrative、决定 evidence order 并优先占据 token budget 时，什么 contract 才能证明 fixed reader 得到的是 trajectory-supported experience，而不是一个更会写答案的中间层？
payload.sourceNote: arXiv v1 work-in-progress preprint；PDF 共 32 页。paper-day release、August query-boundary fix 与 current source 分开标注；两组 public tests 分别停在 built-context contract 与 model-free selection/intervention feasibility，不执行 controller、fixed reader 或 benchmark reproduction。

designTransfer.when: agent 会把历史轨迹改写成供另一个 reader 使用的 evidence packet。
designTransfer.move: 让每段派生叙述可回到具体来源，并把“找到一个有效 span”和“该 span 真支持这段话”分开检查；记录 context 截断位置。
designTransfer.check: 固定同一 packet，分别提供有效支持、无效位置和指向反值的 decoy；检查现有接收路径会不会把无支持叙述直接交给 reader。
designTransfer.boundary: 这是迁移检查建议，未运行新的 reader 或 controller。已有 synthetic contract test 证明特定 postprocessing 接收边界，不能说明实际生成频率或 benchmark gain。
designTransfer.basis: 既有札记 §3.3、Appendix E、public synthetic artifact 与 “编者判断”：authored evidence object。
